text: In the two days since the last run (11 November), beauty again gained by far the most new reviews (about 23,300), led by a ₹138 Wildplay perfume (+3,571), while home & kitchen jumped to about 12,800 new reviews thanks to a ₹152 Kuber yantra (+2,081), ₹118 wall stickers (+1,961) and a ₹176 LED rope light (+1,897). For a beginner, home & kitchen and jewellery still look best, with kids' toys and bags close behind.

headline: Women's ethnic: huge demand, but sizes and returns
text: Kurtis lead with the biggest sellers (a ₹295 kurta with about 122,000 reviews), and the category added about 2,900 new reviews since the last run, led by a ₹380 cotton silk jacquard saree (+389), a ₹237 kurti (+207) and a ₹303 Banarasi saree (+202). Eight listings are new, mostly bandhani and printed sarees around ₹290, which fits the wedding season running through December. The typical price is about ₹291, but about 9.1% of reviews are 1-star, and sellers are concentrated in Gujarat (27) and Rajasthan (11), so competition is strong. Sizes, fabric complaints and returns make this hard for a beginner; sarees (no size) are the easier part if you try it.

headline: Women's western: winter jackets and tops moving
text: Tops lead the category, with a ₹162 tank top combo at about 150,000 reviews, and the category added about 2,700 new reviews since the last run. The fastest movers were a ₹194 women's shirt (+273), a ₹294 girls' jacket (+193) and a ₹293 jacket (+181), and the seven new listings are mostly sweaters, sweatshirts and jackets, so winter wear is clearly rising. The typical price is about ₹286 with about 7.5% 1-star reviews, and Delhi sellers dominate (20 of 39). It is doable, but sizes and returns make it a medium choice for a beginner.

headline: Men's clothing: slow growth, shifting to hoodies
text: Checked shirts still lead (a ₹248 shirt with about 105,000 reviews), but the category gained only about 740 new reviews since the last run, the slowest of all. The movers are winter items: a ₹432 hooded sweatshirt (+210) and ₹326 black hoodies (+93), while new listings include formal and denim shirts. The typical price is about ₹326 and about 11.9% of reviews are 1-star, one of the highest complaint rates. Sellers are in Rajasthan (11), Punjab (7) and Delhi (7); slow growth plus sizes and complaints make this hard for a beginner.

headline: Kids & toys: winter sets rising, toys are the easy part
text: Kids' clothing sets lead, and the category added about 3,900 new reviews since the last run, led by a ₹182 three-pack shorts set (+410), a ₹203 kids' sweater set (+299) and a ₹184 baby girl dress (+293). New listings are mostly thermal and winter sets, and a ₹112 wooden coin box (gullak) is rising fast on the toy side. The typical price is about ₹190 with about 8.6% 1-star reviews, and sellers are spread across West Bengal (10), Gujarat (7) and Delhi (5). Toys and puzzles have no sizes, so they are the beginner-friendly part, and Christmas in six weeks should help gifting demand.

headline: Home & kitchen: biggest jump of the day, decor and lights leading
text: Diyas, wallpaper and wall decor lead this category, and it added about 12,800 new reviews since the last run, the second most of any category. The fastest movers were a ₹152 Kuber Bhandari yantra (+2,081), ₹118 wall stickers (+1,961) and a ₹176 LED rope light (+1,897), likely post-Diwali orders being reviewed, and new listings include kitchen runner doormats and knife sets. The typical price is low at about ₹164 with about 8.4% 1-star reviews, and sellers are in Gujarat (11), Delhi (7) and Uttar Pradesh (5). Light, no-size items with few complaints make this one of the best beginner categories, and string lights should stay in demand for Christmas and New Year.

headline: Beauty: most reviews by far, but brands rule
text: Beauty again gained the most new reviews, about 23,300 since the last run, led by a ₹138 Wildplay perfume (+3,571), a ₹296 Ghar Soaps de-tan face wash (+2,383) and a ₹149 French Essence body spray (+2,119). The top sellers are brands such as Ghar Soaps, Muuchstac and Mamaearth, and winter body lotions like Vaseline and cocoa butter are rising. The typical price is about ₹205 with about 8.3% 1-star reviews, and sellers are in Karnataka (6), Maharashtra (5) and Delhi (4). Demand is huge, but most winners are brands that need approval, so this is hard for a beginner unless you have your own product. Only 30 products were read here.

headline: Jewellery: light, cheap and in the middle of wedding season
text: American diamond jewellery sets lead, and the category added about 2,600 new reviews since the last run, led by a ₹165 choker set (+929), a ₹142 rhodium plated set (+455) and a ₹151 golden bracelet (+196). Eight listings are new, mostly pearl and alloy sets and toe rings, and a ₹243 chunky mangalsutra and a ₹148 four-piece combo keep rising, which fits the wedding season through December. The typical price is about ₹178 with about 7.4% 1-star reviews, and sellers are mainly in Gujarat (15) and Maharashtra (13). Jewellery is light, has no sizes and needs no brand licence, so it remains one of the best beginner choices.

headline: Bags & footwear: bags steady, Delhi sellers dominate
text: Handbags lead (a ₹251 handbag with about 68,000 reviews), and the category added about 2,000 new reviews since the last run, led by a ₹166 printed shoulder tote (+126), a ₹218 women's backpack (+122) and a ₹151 sling bag (+117). New listings are mostly slippers and flip-flop combos, and ₹132 bellies and ₹297 sneakers are rising. The typical price is about ₹209 with a low 7.3% 1-star rate, but Delhi sellers dominate (26 of 39). Bags have no sizes, so they suit a beginner better than footwear.

headline: Electronics: cables and stands fine, earbuds risky
text: A ₹382 wooden Bluetooth speaker and ₹82 phone stands lead, and the category added about 2,700 new reviews since the last run, led by a ₹193 4-in-1 charging cable (+814), the speaker (+268) and the phone stand (+187). New listings include a mini speaker, a desktop phone holder and branded earbuds, and a ₹186 selfie stick tripod is rising. The typical price is about ₹325, but about 12% of reviews are 1-star, the highest of any category, and sellers are split between Haryana, Delhi and Gujarat (12 each). Simple stands and cables are a medium choice; avoid earbuds and speakers, which draw the most complaints.

headline: Health & fitness: pads dominate, small wellness items move
text: Sanitary pads lead (everteen pads with about 197,000 reviews), and the category added about 6,600 new reviews since the last run, led by a ₹128 Dabur Red toothpaste combo (+1,308), a ₹100 bamboo toothbrush (+1,213) and ₹68 invisible earlobe patches (+677). New listings include hot water bags, which fits the winter, and footballs are rising on the sports side. Complaints are the lowest of all at about 5.4% 1-star, the typical price is about ₹223, and sellers are in Delhi (10), Uttar Pradesh (8) and Punjab (8). Many top items are branded, but unbranded earlobe patches, bamboo toothbrushes and hot water bags are reasonable beginner picks.

headline: Wall shelves: steady but small, adhesive bathroom shelves joining
text: Only 20 products were read from this single list, and they gained about 420 new reviews since the last run, led by a ₹313 plain wooden shelf (+77), a ₹351 wooden TV-unit wall shelf (+40) and a ₹131 planter wall shelf (+35). The top listing is still a ₹91 wall-mounted mobile holder (about 27,500 reviews), and three of the four new listings are self-adhesive steel bathroom shelves around ₹180. The typical price is about ₹181 with a low 7.1% 1-star rate, and sellers are in Uttar Pradesh (7), Rajasthan (6) and Gujarat (5). Demand is real but much smaller than jewellery or kitchen items, and wooden shelves are bulkier to ship, so this is a medium choice; small decorative or adhesive shelves around ₹130 to ₹180 are the easiest way in.

LED string and rope lights around ₹150 to ₹180 (Christmas and New Year)
American diamond and choker jewellery sets around ₹140 to ₹200 (wedding season)
Wall stickers and self-adhesive wallpaper around ₹120 to ₹150
Sling bags and printed tote bags around ₹150 to ₹220
Invisible earlobe patches and bamboo toothbrushes around ₹70 to ₹100
Simple toys and wooden coin boxes around ₹100 to ₹200 (Christmas gifting)

Avoid for now: men's shirts (slowest growth and 11.9% 1-star reviews), earbuds and speakers (12% 1-star and copy-brand risk), branded beauty and sanitary products that need brand approval, and size-heavy clothing like kurtis with 9%+ 1-star reviews.
